subject: inaccurate barplot when user selects independent variable (shiny), displays fine without user input

messages.author: 371abfcac77b8e14
messages.subject: inaccurate barplot when user selects independent variable (shiny), displays fine without user input
parts:
Can anyone tell me why the barplots in the following code do not match?

```{r, echo=FALSE}
setwd("C:###path")
fs<- (read.csv("testfile.csv"))
library(shiny)

shinyApp(
ui= fluidPage(
    titlePanel("Analysis of Survey Responses for Private Label Ice Cream brands in 7 Summit dataset"),
    selectInput("perc", "perception:", choices=colnames(fs)),
    plotOutput("plot1"),
 
    mainPanel(
        )
    ),
###TROUBLE START
server = function(input,output){
  output$plot1<-renderPlot({barplot(sapply(split(fs$q1_7,input$perc),mean),ylab="Satisfaction")})
}
)
barplot(sapply(split(fs$q1_7,fs$X),mean)) ###WHY DOESNT THIS LOOK LIKE THE PLOT ABOVE?
##TROUBLE END
```

the data set is attached for reference. Thank you in advance.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: inaccurate barplot when user selects independent variable (shiny), displays fine without user input
parts:
split(fs$q1_7,input$perc)
needs to be
split(fs$q1_7,fs[[input$perc]])
since input$perc is merely the name of the selected column, not the column itself.
